hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'git push' || exit 0; dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // "."'); cd "$dir" && repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$repo" && npm run build && npm test || { echo 'QA failed — blocking git push' >&2; exit 2; }
